title: [Opus 5.5] [Non-commercial] various House types generator
author: RageshAntony
selftext:
Using Claude Opus 5.5 , I created a building generator. 

====

Procedural 3D house generator on Babylon.js 9. You give it a style id, or a group such as "any Indian style", and a seed. It returns a house model with real-world dimensions and PBR materials, plus a report of the engineering checks it ran. You can export the building as GLB or FBX, or add it to your own Babylon scene.

* 90 architectural styles in 7 categories and 18 house types, from more than 40 countries and cultures.
* Style groups: generate from any style of a country, region, type or category, or from the whole catalogue.
* Every generation records its design decisions (plan form, roof, storeys, materials, palette, features) as a variant signature. Pass recent signatures back and you get a house that is visibly different.
* Every house is sized by a rules engine: roof pitch for the covering, wall thickness and slenderness, stilts, vaults, battered walls, cantilevers, beam span and depth, column spacing, opening layout, stairs, guards and chimneys.
* Exports contain the building only. Ground, streets, trees and plants stay out unless you ask for them.
* PBR materials are synthesized in code (albedo, normal and ORM maps), so the library needs no image assets.
* Generation needs no renderer. It runs in browsers, web workers and Node.
* The same seed always gives the same house.

===

I love the project. just for curiosity, I created this. Eventhough many short comings and bugs, still it's wonderful to see how AI can create a full fledged software.
